title.en: Preparation of the cash flow statement

hook.en: We have computed operating, investing and financing cash flows separately. Now we assemble them into one statement and check that it agrees with the cash in the Balance Sheet.
hook.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಣಕಾಸು ನಗದು ಹರಿವುಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ. ಈಗ ಅವನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯ ನಗದಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ತಾಳೆ ನೋಡೋಣ.

objectives.en: State the format of the cash flow statement (indirect method)
Prepare a complete cash flow statement
Reconcile with opening and closing cash

narration.en: We have computed operating, investing and financing cash flows separately. Now we assemble them into one statement and check that it agrees with the cash in the Balance Sheet.
narration.kn: ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ, ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಣಕಾಸು ನಗದು ಹರಿವುಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಲೆಕ್ಕಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ. ಈಗ ಅವನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯ ನಗದಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ತಾಳೆ ನೋಡೋಣ.

body.en: A. Cash flows from operating activities (net profit before tax → adjustments → operating profit before WC changes → WC changes → cash generated → less tax paid). B. Cash flows from investing activities. C. Cash flows from financing activities. Net increase/decrease in cash and cash equivalents (A + B + C) + opening cash and cash equivalents = closing cash and cash equivalents.
body.kn: ತಃಖ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು: ಎ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ, ಬಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ, ಸಿ ಹಣಕಾಸು. ಇವುಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ ನಗದಿನ ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ; ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ನಗದು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂತಿಮ ನಗದು ಬರಬೇಕು.

points.en: A + B + C = net change in cash

narration.en: The statement has three sections, A operating, B investing and C financing. Their total is the net change in cash, which plus opening cash must equal closing cash.
narration.kn: ತಃಖ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು: ಎ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ, ಬಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ, ಸಿ ಹಣಕಾಸು. ಇವುಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ ನಗದಿನ ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ; ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ನಗದು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ ಅಂತಿಮ ನಗದು ಬರಬೇಕು.

blocks.formula: \text{Closing cash and cash equivalents} = \text{Opening} + (A + B + C)

title.en: On the board: Putting it together

narration.en: Start with opening cash and cash equivalents: fifty thousand.

say.en: Start with opening cash and cash equivalents: fifty thousand.
Operating activities bring in two lakh eighty thousand.
Investing uses one lakh ninety thousand; financing brings in one lakh ten thousand.
Net increase two lakh; closing cash two lakh fifty thousand, which must agree with the Balance Sheet.

title.en: Try it: from opening to closing cash

caption.en: Set the net cash flow of each activity (negative means cash used) and the opening balance. The statement must end at the closing cash in the Balance Sheet.

narration.en: Opening cash plus the three activities equals closing cash: the statement is a bridge between two Balance Sheets.

tryThis.en: A growing firm often has negative B and positive C. Why?
Find a combination where cash falls even though operating cash flow is positive.

problem.en: Using the previous lessons’ figures for Kaveri Ltd.: net cash from operating activities ₹2,80,000; net cash used in investing ₹1,90,000; net cash from financing ₹1,10,000; opening cash and cash equivalents ₹50,000. Complete the statement.

steps.en: B. Investing activities: (₹1,90,000). C. Financing activities: + ₹1,10,000.
Closing cash and cash equivalents = 50,000 + 2,00,000 = ₹2,50,000, which must agree with the Balance Sheet.

answer.en: Net increase ₹2,00,000; closing cash and cash equivalents ₹2,50,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ; ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Three sections: A operating, B investing, C financing.
points.kn: ಮೂರು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು: ಎ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ, ಬಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ, ಸಿ ಹಣಕಾಸು.

points.en: A + B + C = net increase or decrease in cash.
points.kn: ಎ + ಬಿ + ಸಿ = ನಗದಿನ ನಿವ್ವಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ ಅಥವಾ ಇಳಿಕೆ.

points.en: Opening cash + net change must equal closing cash in the Balance Sheet.
points.kn: ಆರಂಭಿಕ ನಗದು + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ = ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯ ಅಂತಿಮ ನಗದು.

homework.en: Prepare a full cash flow statement from two years’ Balance Sheets given by your teacher.

narration.en: Recap. Three sections: A operating, B investing, C financing. A + B + C = net increase or decrease in cash. Opening cash + net change must equal closing cash in the Balance Sheet.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೂರು ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು: ಎ ಕಾರ್ಯಾಚರಣಾ, ಬಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ, ಸಿ ಹಣಕಾಸು. ಎ + ಬಿ + ಸಿ = ನಗದಿನ ನಿವ್ವಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ ಅಥವಾ ಇಳಿಕೆ. ಆರಂಭಿಕ ನಗದು + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ = ಆಸ್ತಿ-ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ ತಃಖ್ತೆಯ ಅಂತಿಮ ನಗದು.
